description: Passport Index API provides request-based access to real-time visa-policy and visa-free-list data for every country. Its data is sourced from government agencies and updated in real time, with government agencies prioritized for API access.
resolution_notes: docs_url: Replace the legacy URL with the current official API Request page: https://discover.passportindex.org/api-request/. description: Replace it because the official page documents real-time visa-policy and visa-free-list data, request-based access, and priority for government agencies; it does not support the VisaList attribution or claim documented ranking endpoints. Evidence: https://discover.passportindex.org/api-request/.
